dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent white fringes creating sharp boundary lines along the margins of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, high-contrast white patch visible on the lateral portion of the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct boundary; low-contrast transition between the uniformly dark crown and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright red coloration on the distal portion of the beak.
